title: the Old Mill House Rising Revisited
author: Jonah Coldharbour
blurb: Ulyana Almeida, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the bakery lease runs out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
